    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.

        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.

        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.

    remaining = bins - item
    # Avoid negative or zero remaining space (overfilled bins)
    valid_remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)

    # Use inverse of remaining space to prioritize bins with less leftover space (closer to optimal fit)

    # Ensure bins that cannot fit the item have very low priority
    fits = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores *= fits.astype(float)
    return priority_scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.

        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.

    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(valid):

    fill_ratio = (bins - remaining) / bins

    return priorities

        log_remaining = np.log1p(abs_remaining)
        combined = gaussian_penalty * log_remaining
        priorities[valid] = combined
    return priorities
